google.label: Google Sign-In
google.description: Ndị ọrụ nwere ike ịbanye na Google
google.step1: Mepee Google Cloud Console wee họrọ ọrụ dị adị, ma ọ bụ mepụta otu maka ụlọ ahịa a.
google.step2: N'okpuru APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen, dejupụta aha ngwa, email nkwado na ngalaba enyere ikike, wee bipụta ngwa ahụ. Ọ bụrụhaala na ọ nọ na Testing, naanị ndị ọrụ nnwale ị depụtara nwere ike ịbanye.
google.step3: Gaa Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID wee họrọ Web application dị ka ụdị ya.
google.step6: Detuo Client ID na Client secret n'ime ubi ndị dị n'elu, chekwaa, wee pịa Nyochaa nzere. Ndị ahịa Google ọhụrụ nwere ike iwe nkeji ole na ole tupu ha amalite ịrụ ọrụ.

facebook.label: Facebook Sign-In
facebook.description: Ndị ọrụ nwere ike ịbanye na Facebook
facebook.step1: Mepee Meta for Developers → My Apps → Create app, wee họrọ ebumnuche “Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login”.
facebook.step2: Tinye ngwaahịa Facebook Login na ngwa ahụ, wee mepee Facebook Login → Settings.
facebook.step3: Gbanye Client OAuth login na Web OAuth login, wee tinye nke a n'okpuru Valid OAuth Redirect URIs:
facebook.step4: Na App settings → Basic, tọọ Site URL ka ọ bụrụ
facebook.step4c: n'okpuru App domains. Meta na-achọkwa URL Iwu Nzuzo tupu ngwa ahụ enwee ike ịdị ndụ.
facebook.step5: Detuo App ID na App Secret n'ime ubi ndị dị n'elu, chekwaa, wee pịa Nyochaa nzere.
facebook.step6: Gbanwee ngwa ahụ site na Development gaa na Live. Ruo mgbe ahụ, naanị ndị nwere ọrụ na ngwa ahụ nwere ike iji Facebook banye.

oauth.envCredentials: Edobere nzere onye na-eweta nke a site na environment variables — gbanye ya iji jiri ha.
oauth.originMismatch: Ị nọ na {browser}, mana ịbanye na-agba site na {configured}. Debanye URL ndị egosiri n'okpuru — ma ọ bụ tụọ BETTER_AUTH_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL na ngalaba ị na-eji n'ezie.

oauth.httpsRequiredFacebook: Meta na-anabata naanị redirect URI HTTPS ọha — a jụrụ localhost. Mepee ibe a na ngalaba gị dị ndụ, ma ọ bụ ụzọ HTTPS, tupu ị debanye ya.

oauth.verifyHint: Nyocha na-anwale ID na secret n'aka onye na-eweta. Ma edebanyere redirect URI, naanị ezigbo ịbanye ga-egosi ya.

localRetired.title: Local storage has been retired
localRetired.body: Faịlụ ndị dị na sava a ga-anọgide na-adọta, mana nbugo ọhụrụ chọrọ otu n'ime ndị na-eweta ọrụ dị n'okpuru. Họrọ otu, tinye ozi nzere ya, wee mepee “Bufee faịlụ ndị ị nwere ugbua” — iwu ndị ahụ na ndabere a ga-ewere tupu mbugharị ọzọ dị ebe ahụ.

cloudflare_r2.bucket: Na dashboard Cloudflare mepee R2 → Create bucket. Aha ya na-abanye na Aha bucket n'elu.
cloudflare_r2.token: R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens → Create API token, ikike Object Read & Write, naanị maka bucket ahụ. Detuo akụkụ abụọ ahụ n'ime Access Key ID na Secret Access Key n'elu — a na-egosi nzuzo ahụ naanị otu ugboro.
cloudflare_r2.account: Detuo Account ID nwere mkpụrụedemede 32 site na mpịakọta akụkụ nke peeji R2 gaa na R2 Account ID.
cloudflare_r2.public: Bucket → Settings → Public access: gbanye subdomain r2.dev ma ọ bụ jikọọ ngalaba nke gị, wee tinye adreesị ahụ na Public URL.
cloudflare_r2.test: Pịa Nwalee njikọ, wee chekwaa. Nnwale ahụ na-ebugo otu faịlụ nnwale ma gụọ ya ọzọ site na public URL, ya mere ọ ga-ada ma ọ bụrụ na ị wụfere nzọụkwụ gara aga.
cloudflare_r2.caution: Na-enweghị Public URL, foto ngwaahịa ọ bụla ga-eweghachi 403 na ihe nchọgharị ọbụna ma ozi nzere dị mma — faịlụ ndị ahụ na-esi na endpoint R2 nzuzo, nke a na-adịghị agụ na-enweghị nyocha. Ngalaba nke gị ka mma karịa r2.dev: CDN Cloudflare na-azaghachi arịrịọ echekwara na-anaghị ana bucket ụgwọ.

s3.bucket: Mepụta bucket na console S3 ma dekọọ mpaghara ya — ọ ga-adaba na mpaghara ahọpụtara n'elu.
s3.iam: IAM → mepụta onye ọrụ nwere ohere mmemme na iwu na-enye ikike ndị a na bucket ahụ:
s3.public: Kwe ka ọha gụọ site na iwu bucket, ma ọ bụ tinye CloudFront n'ihu ya, wee tinye adreesị ahụ na Public URL.
s3.test: Tinye ụzọ igodo abụọ n'elu, pịa Nwalee njikọ, wee chekwaa.
s3.caution: Bucket ọhụrụ na-abịa na Block all public access agbanyere. Hapụ ya ka ọ dị naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-eji CloudFront — ma ọ bụghị ya, foto ọ bụla n'ụlọ ahịa ga-eweghachi 403.

minio.run: Gbaa MinIO n'akụkụ ngwa ahụ — Coolify na Dokploy nwere ihe nlereanya otu pịa. Tinye volume na /data, ma ọ bụghị ya, mbugharị na-esote ga-ewepụ faịlụ niile ebugoro.
minio.keys: Mepee console MinIO (ọdụ 9001 na ndabara), mepụta bucket, wee Access Keys → Create access key.
minio.public: Kwe ka ihe nchọgharị gụọ bucket ahụ:
minio.fields: Endpoint URL bụ adreesị API (ọdụ 9000), ọ bụghị console. Mpaghara nwere ike ịnọgide na us-east-1 — MinIO na-eleghara ya anya. Public URL bụ ebe ihe nchọgharị na-eru bucket.
minio.caution: Nye MinIO site na HTTPS na subdomain nke ya. Ihe nchọgharị na-egbochi ọdịnaya agwakọtara, ya mere endpoint http:// na-emebi foto niile n'ụlọ ahịa HTTPS.

digitalocean.space: Spaces Object Storage → Create a Space. Ebe data ị họọrọ bụ endpoint ahụ (nyc3, fra1, sgp1…), ya mere họrọ nke dị nso na ndị ahịa gị ma họrọ otu mpaghara ahụ n'elu.
digitalocean.keys: API → Spaces Keys → Generate New Key, wee detuo akụkụ abụọ ahụ n'ime Access Key ID na Secret Access Key.
digitalocean.public: Space → Settings → mee ka File Listing bụrụ nke ọha, ma ọ bụ gbanye CDN.
digitalocean.test: Hapụ Public URL ka ọ tọgbọrọ chakoo iji nye site na Space n'onwe ya, ma ọ bụ tinye endpoint CDN (…cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com) iji nye site na nsọtụ. Mgbe ahụ nwalee njikọ ma chekwaa.

migration.title: Bufee faịlụ ndị ị nwere ugbua
migration.intro: Ịhọrọ onye na-eweta ọrụ na-agbanwe naanị ebe nbugo ọhụrụ ga-aga. Ihe niile ebugoro na mbụ na-anọgide ebe ọ dị ma na-adọta ruo mgbe ị bufere ya.
migration.step1: Hazie onye na-eweta ọrụ n'elu ma pịa Nwalee njikọ — mbufe na-ebugo n'ime ihe echekwara ebe a.
migration.step2: Bufee ozi nzere echekwara gaa n'usoro nke onye na-eweta ọrụ ọ bụla. Ọ dị mma na ụdị ọ bụla, ọ dịghịkwa eme ihe ọ bụla ozugbo ọ gbara otu ugboro.
migration.step3: Bugoo faịlụ ndị dị na sava ma degharịa URL ha n'ime ọdụ data niile. Ọsọ nnwale na-edepụta faịlụ ọ bụla ma ọ naghị ede ihe ọ bụla.
migration.step4: Lelee ụlọ ahịa na Media Library. A naghị ehichapụ ihe ọ bụla na diski, ya mere wepụ ndetu mpaghara n'aka gị ozugbo foto malitere ịpụta.
migration.backup: Tupu mbugharị ọzọ: ọ bụrụ na usoro mmelite gị na-edochi nchekwa ngwa — nbugo cPanel, ide zip n'elu, kontena na-enweghị volume — buru ụzọ detuo media si na sava. Idochi nchekwa ahụ na-ehichapụ ha.
migration.note: Faịlụ nke dara ịbugo na-ejigide URL mpaghara ya, ya mere ọsọ na-ezughị ezu na-ahapụ ụlọ ahịa na-arụ ọrụ karịa nke gbajiri ọkara. Ịgba ọzọ dị mma.
